title: I · A signal across the water
why: Firstlight was built around a surviving crossing stone. Rowan needs a new wayfarer who can carry its signal to Briarhaven.

title: II · A blade made by your hands
why: The crossing cannot promise safe roads. Forge your own tool, then help Vale deal with the giant rats threatening the stores.

title: III · Supplies for the crossing
why: Firstlight survives because its people share their work. Bring timber to Nell, prepare food with Bram and secure supplies with Ada.

title: IV · The First Accord
why: The crossing answers a living bond. Sera will help you choose the Spirit that shapes your first journey into Veldren.
